title: Spike: did_webvh record as an app_data_dictionary component updated by AppDataUpdate
description: Question (Mark): draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential keeps did_webvh_heads as a GroupContext extension changed by GroupContextExtensions proposals. RFC 9420 allows one GCE per Commit; mimid refuses a record-changing Commit while a GCE proposal is pending (DidWebvhError::PendingGroupContextExtensions, Open Issue 5; feedback items 18, 28). Does carrying the record as an app_data_dictionary component changed by AppDataUpdate (mls-extensions-11 §4.6, §4.7) remove the collision and simplify the hub (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.22)? Prototype behind a code-point switch (GCE form stays default), run: revocation with a pending unrelated GCE, the Update-proposal fallback with a pending GCE, two record changes in one Commit, hub enforcement. Findings in docs/didwebvh-appdata-spike.md and a feedback item. Branch didwebvh-appdata; no push.
